text: Aur jo Allah par bharosa kare, to Allah usay kaafi hai.
author: Surah At-Talaq 65:3

text: ye na thi hamari qismat ki visal-e-yar hota / agar aur jite rahte yahi intizar hota
author: Mirza Ghalib

text: Khudi ko kar buland itna ki har taqdir se pahle, / Khuda bande se khud puchhe bata teri raza kya hai.
author: Allama Iqbal

text: Ae mere Rab, in dono par reham farma, / jaise inhon ne bachpan mein meri parwarish ki.
author: Surah Al-Isra 17:24

text: Ae hamare Rab, hamein duniya mein bhi bhalai de, / aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai, aur hamein aag ke azaab se bacha.
author: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201

text: Ae imaan walo, sabr aur namaz se madad lo, / beshak Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.
author: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:153

text: Patta patta boota boota haal hamara jaane hai, / jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane, baagh to saara jaane hai.
author: Mir Taqi Mir

text: Hazaron khwahishen aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle, / bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle.
author: Mirza Ghalib

text: Bas ki dushwar hai har kaam ka aasan hona, / aadmi ko bhi mayassar nahin insaan hona.
author: Mirza Ghalib

text: Mohabbat mein nahin hai farq jeene aur marne ka, / usi ko dekh kar jeete hain jis kafir pe dam nikle.
author: Mirza Ghalib

text: Nahin hai na-umeed Iqbal apni kisht-e-veeran se, / zara nam ho to ye mitti bahut zarkhez hai saqi.
author: Allama Iqbal

text: Tum mere paas hote ho goya, / jab koi dusra nahin hota.
author: Momin Khan Momin

text: Tu shaheen hai, parwaz hai kaam tera, / tere samne aasman aur bhi hain.
author: Allama Iqbal

text: Apne man mein doob kar pa ja suragh-e-zindagi, / tu agar mera nahin banta na ban, apna to ban.
author: Allama Iqbal

text: Ranj se khugar hua insan to mit jata hai ranj, / mushkilen mujh par padin itni ki aasan ho gain.
author: Mirza Ghalib

text: Hain log wahi jahan mein achchhe, / aate hain jo kaam dusron ke.
author: Allama Iqbal

text: Sitaron se aage jahan aur bhi hain, / abhi ishq ke imtihan aur bhi hain.
author: Allama Iqbal

text: Yaqin mohkam, amal paiham, mohabbat fatah-e-alam, / jihad-e-zindagani mein hain ye mardon ki shamshiren.
author: Allama Iqbal
